subject: English
passage: Every last detail of the archaeological excavation, which spanned four months and two weeks, ______ carefully documented by the research team.
prompt: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The convention being tested is subject-verb agreement. The singular verb "was" agrees in number with the singular subject "every last detail."

Why A is incorrect:

Choice A is incorrect because the plural verb "have been" doesn't agree in number with the singular subject "every last detail."
